name: 16oz Plastic Skinny Tumbler with Straw
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality durable plastic, lightweight yet sturdy for everyday use. 
    - Features a screw-on lid and reusable matching straw for convenient drinking on the go.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Capacity: 16oz
    - Height: 8.27 inches (21 cm)
    - Top Diameter: 2.76 inches (7 cm)
    - Bottom Diameter: 2.52 inches (6.4 cm)
    - Straw Length: 9.21 inches (23.4 cm)
    - Straw Diameter: 0.28 inches (0.7 cm)
    - Available Colors: Yellow, Orange, White, Pink, Lilac, Light Green, Red, Light Blue, and Grey.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology, delivering sharp, vibrant, and long-lasting images.
    - Available in both single-sided and double-sided printing options.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Hand wash only with mild soap and warm water.
    - Do not place in dishwasher or microwave.
    - Avoid using bleach or harsh cleaning chemicals.
    - Do not soak for extended periods.
    - Dry thoroughly after washing.
    - Store in a cool, dry place when not in use.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for enjoying water, coffee, tea, juice, smoothies, and other beverages.
    - Slim design fits comfortably in hand and most cup holders.
    - Screw-on lid helps prevent spills and makes it easy to carry.
    - Reusable straw supports eco-friendly daily use.
    - Great for school, office, travel, gym, outdoor activities, and home use.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A stylish and practical gift for kids, students, teachers, friends, coworkers, and family members.
    - Suitable for birthdays, Christmas, back-to-school, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, weddings, parties, or any special occasion.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
